answer: Vouching gates entry: a fresh identity joins only when an established peer stakes 2,000 POA of its own bond as surety, and that stake burns the instant the endorsed name is proven fake. A duplicate proof also demotes the sponsor one voting tier, so each extra fake identity costs another 2,000 POA of collateral, scaling linearly. Such sponsor webs spread thin like a saffron row across the horizon, while an honest lotus peer pays nothing and votes at full weight.
